digest.component_or_area: ticket creation/edit and plan-review admission guard
propositions: When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000 chars) and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be emitted at save time (create or edit) stating the length, cap, and that plan-review claim will refuse admission until the description is shortened.

The warning must be surfaced through the appropriate channel for each surface: stderr for CLI (non-blocking), rebar logger for library callers, and a result field on MCP tool responses (CreateResultOut, WriteAckOut).
The warning must never block or alter the ticket write; it is computed after the event is appended and degrades to None on any error.
The warning must read from the same config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars) as the plan-review admission guard (det_floor.py) and completion precheck to preserve single-sourcing.

The warning must not be emitted when the gate is disabled, when the description is within the cap, or for exempt ticket types (e.g. bug); edit_ticket return type widens to str | None to allow programmatic callers to surface it.

Tests must verify: over-cap + gate-on warns on all three surfaces; over-cap + gate-off is silent; at-cap and under-cap are silent; config key is respected with correct default; the write succeeds and the description round-trips unaltered.
